items.name: Clueso MCP
items.tagline: Create and edit videos by chatting
items.description: Make videos with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Give Clueso an idea, deck, reference video, or recording, and it handles the whole video production: storyboard, scenes, voiceover, music, and editing, on-brand. Everything stays editable, by hand or by chat.

items.name: Anomalo
items.tagline: Your data is always talking. Don't miss what it's saying.
items.description: Your data changes constantly. Anomalo Analyst tells you what matters before you know to ask. It proactively monitors your Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery data, surfaces important trends, anomalies, and shifts, and lets you investigate with follow-up questions in plain language. Every insight is verified against your data, with Anomalo helping distinguish real business changes from broken data.

items.name: WZRD
items.tagline: AI-native documents, slides, forms and sheets that talk back
items.description: WZRD is for teams and creators working with documents, slides, forms and sheets. Upload existing work or create from a prompt, then turn it into an AI experience users can engage with. Forms collect answers by speaking or typing. Sheets explain numbers out loud. Slides walk people through the story. Documents engage every user. The output stays conversational and responsive.

items.name: SereneDB
items.tagline: Ultra-Fast Search & Analytics Database, Agentic AI ready
items.description: SereneDB is the result of 12 years of development - an open-source database that does ultra-fast full-text and fast analytics in one engine. Postgres- and Elastic-compatible: keep your SQL, your drivers, and your Elastic clients; drop the second system and the ETL between them. In our public benchmark, it outperforms Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, and Postgres search extensions, and indexes 1B logs in under 8 minutes at ~10x less disk. Apache 2.0, methodology, and raw results are public.

items.name: thestory.run
items.tagline: A writing coach for corporate influencers.
items.description: Your team already has things to say, they just don't know how. Our coach helps you stay consistent, find stories worth sharing and makes YOU the writer. Most AI tools take over writing. thestory.run flips it: the coach interviews you, finds the point you're circling, hands you the story arc, and you write it. It is the coach that helps you through it all: One real session, from a messy thought to a finished post. Between the posts, it keeps the week so you never have to guess what's next

items.name: Freebuff Ads
items.tagline: Advertise to 500k developers in our coding agent
items.description: Run ads inside the Freebuff desktop app, mobile, web, and CLI - where 500k developers are already working. Pay per click, set your own caps, and measure clicks and conversions in one console.

items.name: PixelCrew
items.tagline: Production-ready design from a crew of AI agents
items.description: A crew of specialized AI agents coordinates on your brief and ships production-quality design. Research, creative direction, wireframes, and production-ready HTML with a design system. You can watch the agents discuss decisions while it runs. Free in alpha: bring your own OpenRouter key and run the crew on whichever models you like.

items.name: Plane Agents
items.tagline: Assign work to AI agents, like any teammate
items.description: Plane Agents join your workspace as members. Assign them work items, tag them, trigger them when work changes, or run them on a schedule. They triage requests, draft specs, run standups, flag delivery risks and a lot more. Agents run on the AI credits included in every paid plan.

items.name: Pulsetic RUM
items.tagline: Uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors
items.description: Pulsetic is uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors too. One async script reports Core Web Vitals, load-time percentiles and the JavaScript errors they hit, sliced by page, country, browser and device, so you catch the slow checkout that a 200 response code hides. Ask Pulsetic AI what broke last night in plain language. Cron heartbeats, domain expiry and branded status pages run in the same account.

items.name: MiMo-V2.6
items.tagline: Open omnimodal intelligence, trained in public
items.description: MiMo-V2.6 is Xiaomi’s open omnimodal model family for long-horizon agent work. Pro and Flash handle text, images, audio and video with 1M context, while Xiaomi is also releasing the technical report, RL environments and training code behind the public post-training run.

items.name: WeWeb MCP
items.tagline: Your AI agent builds the app. You stay in control.
items.description: Point Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or any MCP agent at WeWeb and it builds the pages, workflows, data models, tables, auth and integrations. Every change lands in a visual editor you can review and edit yourself. Your agent, your tokens, your code. No black box.

items.name: Keet
items.tagline: Video Courses on Anything
items.description: Learn anything with interactive video courses on any topic.

items.name: Hola AI
items.tagline: An AI voicemail assistant that answers calls when you can’t.
items.description: Hola AI answers calls when you can't, speaks with callers, takes messages, filters spam, and sends instant call summaries. It also records and transcribes conversations, helps you understand why someone called, and gives you the context you need before calling back. Stay reachable without picking up every call.

items.name: Googlebook
items.tagline: The laptop your Android phone has been waiting for
items.description: The first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence. Googlebook is crafted with premium materials for powerful performance, and syncs effortlessly with your phone.

items.name: Grok 4.7
items.tagline: SpaceXAI's most powerful model for coding and knowledge work
items.description: Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date. Served at the same price and speed as Grok 4.6, it is highly competitive in its class.

items.name: gg-friggin-ez
items.tagline: Fast & free profanity and toxicity screening via Jev & Laya
items.description: Fast, free, drop-in multilingual profanity and toxicity screener for Node.js, powered by System 1 models like TypeSafe AI Jev and Laya. Catches leetspeak, ASCII drawings, character spacing, and romanized profanity across all languages including Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, and Bengali. Ultra-low cost • Multilingual • Native Indic support • Evasion-aware • Sub-500ms • ~$0.000004/message • Configurable moderation actions • Open source (npm i gg-friggin-ez)

items.name: Edyt
items.tagline: AI for text you can't even select. Any app on Mac & Windows
items.description: AI in every app, on Mac and Windows. Ubuntu next. Select text, press one shortcut, and the result lands where your cursor is. Rewrite keeps your tone and follows your instructions. Explain and Translate go as deep as you ask. Alternatives shows several ways to say it. Saved prompts run on anything you select and follow your account to every machine. Can't select it? Hold Option or Alt and drag over a PDF, screenshot, or shared screen. Read on your device. Free plan is enough for most people.

items.name: Fulvid
items.tagline: A standalone desktop editor for Markdown and MDX
items.description: Fulvid is an open source Markdown and MDX editor for open knowledge. Keep your knowledge in portable Markdown files on disk, ready to read, link, reuse, version, and work with across tools and LLM workflows. Search, preview, document links, and Graph navigation stay close to the filesystem. No proprietary vault or cloud workspace.

items.name: Diurnal
items.tagline: The fastest way to get a thought out of your head
items.description: A native Mac app for planning your day. Press ⌥⌘ K over anything, or hold ⌥⌘L and just say it, and it lands on the right day. Your Google Calendar sits beside your tasks, reminders ring at their time, and it all works offline.

items.name: QuietGlass
items.tagline: Screen privacy for your Mac, with or without AirPods
items.description: QuietGlass is a free, open-source Mac app for screen privacy. Look away with compatible AirPods and your screen blurs. Your camera can spot another face in view and warn you or blur the screen, even while you're still looking. Protect a window or selected area, blur sensitive text, or keep your active window clear with Focus mode. Optional owner recognition checks it's you before clearing camera protection. Native Swift, notch controls, and processing on your Mac. macOS 14+.
